snippet.title: Unseen Diplomacy 2 - Official Developer Overview Trailer | Women-Led Games x SGF 2025
snippet.description: Join the creative director at developer Triangular Pixels for a deep dive into Unseen Diplomacy 2 in this trailer for the upcoming spy simulation game. Learn about your missions, threats you'll face, and get a behind-the-scenes look at the game's creation. In Unseen Diplomacy 2, you're a Secret Agent during a dangerous time as Evil-doers are plotting to destroy the world. Complete missions, manage your agents & use Intel to narrow down the plot & save the Earth. Play a real-life VR obstacle course using every inch of your room - you will run, roll, sneak & hack to victory! Unseen Diplomacy 2 will be available on Meta Quest and Steam VR.
